notes.title: Update Version 1.0
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]This is the last major update for Survival Hold Your Self.[/p][p]Please read the patch notes. If you have any questions or find any further bugs, please use the Discord server. Thank you.[/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][p]1. Compass display is no longer visible when a different UI is open.[/p][p]2. Game performance improved.[/p][p]3. Sound bugs at the waterfront fixed.[/p][p]4. Bandits sometimes didn't attack the player. Fixed.[/p][p]New Features:[/p][p]You can now purchase an NPC companion from the merchant. This companion can craft items at a crafting table you can build without requiring a request, but it takes a little longer.[/p][p]Thank you for your feedback.[/p]

notes.title: Money reduction from Survival Hold Your Self
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,  Please note that due to current circumstances, I'm reducing the price to $4.99. I've seen some people recently purchase the game for $14.99. If you're still eligible for a refund, I recommend returning the game and, once you've received your money back, purchasing it again for significantly less. There will be a final update with bug fixes shortly before the game is removed. You'll also receive another 50 percent discount. Thank you for your understanding. [/p]

notes.title: Withdrawal and removal of Survival Hold Your Self
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, this is probably not good news for you, but I've decided to discontinue Survival Hold Your Self and not develop it any further. Since I have no financial interest in making any more money from it, I will be removing the game from Steam shortly. Thank you for your understanding.[/p]

notes.title: Verion 0.9
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]Here's an update for Survival Hold Your Self. Bugs have been fixed and new content has been added. If you find any further bugs, please use the bug report channel on our Discord server. Thank you.[/p][p]Patch Notes:[/p][p]New:[/p][p]A compass has been added to help players orient themselves.[/p][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][p]1. The helicopter wasn't flying properly.[/p][p]2. Player position wasn't saving correctly.[/p][p]3. Crashes caused by reloading too quickly have been fixed.

[/p][p]I'm planning the next major update for mid-August. Be prepared to be surprised by what follows.[/p]

notes.title: Roadmap Announcement – A Glimpse Into the Future of Our Survival Adventure!
notes.content:
[p]Survivors,
I'm excited to share a glimpse of what's coming next for our game![/p][p]Currently, I’m working on a compass system to help you navigate the world more easily – so you'll always know where north, south, east, and west are.[/p][p]In addition, a very useful feature is in the works: an NPC companion you can purchase from a trader. This loyal helper can [b]craft items for you[/b] without requiring any materials – but it will take a little more time to complete.[/p][p][b]Important:[/b]
If you discover any [b]bugs[/b], please help improve the game by reporting them in the [b]Bug Report Channel[/b] on our [b]Discord server[/b] – your feedback is invaluable![/p][p]Thank you for your support and happy surviving![/p]

notes.title: Releases Start Now
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]The time has finally come and SHYS is being released.[/p][p]I thank everyone who buys the game and wish you lots of fun playing.[/p]

notes.title: Release date
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]Today I want to share with you the exact release date of the EA for Survival Hold Your Self. But first, I'd like to thank the 50 people who have added Survival Hold Your Self to their wishlist. You might also be wondering how much the game will cost.[/p][p]Since it's my first game, I've decided to set a price of $9.99.[/p][p]Now we come to the release date of Survival Hold Your Self. You don't have to wait too long.[/p][p]It's already happening on July 1st.[/p][p]For everyone who decides to buy it, I'd like to thank you in advance and wish you lots of fun with Survival Hold Your Self.[/p][p]I'll publish a roadmap for the release.[/p]

notes.title: Gameplay Features - What can you expect from the game
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today I'd like to give you a list of things you can expect in the game. But first, I'd like to share with you the current status.
I've been working on the save system lately. This difficult topic is now complete and can be checked off. I'm still planning to release the game around August/September, assuming no major issues arise. Therefore, a three-week test phase is now starting, where I'll play through the game myself and look for potential bugs. At the same time, I'll try to add Steam achievements for those who enjoy collecting them. I'll let you know a more precise release date around July. And now we come to the list of what you can expect in the game.


1. Crafting at multiple crafting stations
2. Base building and furniture construction
3. Day-night cycle
4. Quest system (repeatable)
5. Dog companion (purchase from the merchant)
6. Merchant system
7. Open world consists of different islands with different resources and animals.
8. Flying with a helicopter (must be found in the open world)
9. ​​Drill system (Endgame! Drill needs fuel)
10. Looting (with loot reset)
11. Surviving in the wild against wild animals and bandits

notes.title: Gameplay Trailer and Release Date EA
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

I've been working hard on the gameplay trailer over the past few days so you can see it as early as possible. Check out the latest gameplay trailer for Survival Hold Your Self here.


[previewyoutube=2w7IcC1uQyU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Now we come to the news that you're probably most interested in: the EA release.

Unfortunately, I can't give you a 100 percent exact date at the moment. But if everything goes according to plan and there are no further major problems, I'm planning an EA release in late August / early September.

I'll announce the exact date here a few days in advance. Should any unexpected problems arise and the EA release be delayed, I'll let you know in a timely manner.

If you have any further questions or suggestions, feel free to stop by my Discord server. Thanks, see you soon.

notes.title: “Survival: HYS – Now on Twitch & Gameplay Trailer Coming Soon”
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm excited to share two big pieces of news about Survival: Hold Your Self today:

Now available as a Twitch game category!

Survival: Hold Your Self is now officially available as a game category on Twitch.
Whether you're streaming or just browsing, the community can now discover and follow the game even more easily.

This is another step in our journey—and we'd like to thank everyone who has supported us so far with wishlist additions, feedback, and encouragement!

Behind the scenes, I'm currently hard at work on the first official gameplay trailer for Survival: Hold Your Self.

If all goes according to plan, I plan to release it in approximately 4 to 8 weeks.

Once the trailer is complete, I'll announce the official Early Access release date.

I know many of you are excited about it—and so am I—but I want to make sure everything is in place before committing to a firm date. My goal is to provide a stable, enjoyable, and feature-rich experience from day one.
